excluded_candidates.reason: This candidate describes tokenizer augmentation and embedding initialization for gene symbols, which is a model-vocabulary setup detail rather than a separate source-to-model input route. The actual gene-name text inputs are already covered by the text prompt routes.
excluded_candidates.evidence_quote: we augment the base tokenizer with the same canonical human gene symbols used for the 19,260-gene expression panel.
excluded_candidates.uncertainty: The paper does use gene symbols as atomic tokens, but it does not present this as an independent carrier route separate from the surrounding prompt text.
